description:
A guided setup for running Starsector with modern Java 27/28

Latest release: v0.8.0

Windows x64

Recommended Java for Windows - choose Java 27 or Java 28

Experimental Linux x64

Recommended Java for Linux - choose Java 27 or Java 28

Both configurators can download and install a supported Java version automatically.

What is this?

This is an unofficial, self-contained Mikohime package with a guided configurator. It sets up Starsector to use Java 17, Java 27, or Java 28 and generates the launcher and configuration files for you.

The required Mikohime files are included with permission from the original author, Yue (Himemiko). You do not need to install the original Mikohime package separately.

Main features

Guided configuration through Configure_Me.cmd or Configure_Me.shDetects installed Java versions and can install a compatible JDK locallySupports Java 27 27+22-ea and Java 28 28+13-eaMemory and CPU recommendations based on your systemFull, Reduced, and Minimal logging modesOptional Large Pages or Linux huge-page configurationSupport for Fast RenderingOptional installation and configuration of FR Resource CacheOptional installation and configuration of OpenAL Add-onSupport for StarsectorPrepatcher 0.18.4 or newerCreates a ready-to-use platform-specific launcher

A guided setup for running Starsector with modern Java 27/28

Latest release: v0.8.0

Windows x64


Recommended Java for Windows - choose Java 27 or Java 28





Experimental Linux x64


Recommended Java for Linux - choose Java 27 or Java 28





Both configurators can download and install a supported Java version automatically.
What is this?

This is an unofficial, self-contained Mikohime package with a guided configurator. It sets up Starsector to use Java 17, Java 27, or Java 28 and generates the launcher and configuration files for you.
The required Mikohime files are included with permission from the original author, Yue (Himemiko). You do not need to install the original Mikohime package separately.

Main features

  • Guided configuration through Configure_Me.cmd or Configure_Me.sh
  • Detects installed Java versions and can install a compatible JDK locally
  • Supports Java 27 27+22-ea and Java 28 28+13-ea
  • Memory and CPU recommendations based on your system
  • Full, Reduced, and Minimal logging modes
  • Optional Large Pages or Linux huge-page configuration
  • Support for Fast Rendering
  • Optional installation and configuration of FR Resource Cache
  • Optional installation and configuration of OpenAL Add-on
  • Support for StarsectorPrepatcher 0.18.4 or newer
  • Creates a ready-to-use platform-specific launcher
aiDescription: Sets up Starsector to use modern Java versions by generating launcher and configuration files. It includes an unofficial Mikohime package and supports optional components like Fast Rendering, FR Resource Cache, and OpenAL Add-on.

changelog.0.8.0:
Added simpler Recommended, Basic, and Advanced Windows setup workflows
Added clearer system summaries and update checks for optional components
Added an option to securely download, install, and enable FR Resource Cache when Fast Rendering is detected
Added an optional Windows OpenAL Soft 1.25.1 download with backup, repair, recovery, uninstall, and audio configuration support
Added the Toadsector launcher background for Windows and Linux
Redesigned Windows menus, navigation, recommendations, and component management
Improved the safety and consistency of configuration generation
Fixed Java 28 logging and compiler-directive settings across Windows workflows
Fixed component download links incorrectly reporting failures
Fixed menu alignment and inconsistent navigation controls
changelog.0.7.6:
Added stable 64-bit Linux support and the Miko_Rouge.sh launcher
Added Linux LWJGL, OpenAL, and JInput native libraries
Added support for the Linux Fast Rendering fork
Added separate Windows ZIP and Linux tar.gz release packages
Updated Linux to use Starsector's native flat directory layout without starsector-core
Removed StarsectorPrepatcher options from Linux because it is not Linux-compatible; Windows support is unchanged
Fixed an LWJGL native-path error that could cause a Range [0, -1) crash
Improved Windows administrator, write-access, and manual Java-download handling
changelog.0.7.5:
Added an experimental 64-bit Linux configurator and generated Miko_Rouge.sh launcher
Added Linux LWJGL, OpenAL, and JInput native libraries
Added separate Windows and Linux release packages
Added Linux Java, memory, CPU, logging, rendering, cache, and Prepatcher configuration
Added automatic Java installation on Linux with checksum validation
Fixed Linux support for Starsector's native flat installation layout
Fixed Linux relative Java paths and launcher working-directory handling
Improved Windows manual Java-download handling
